title: A geometric approach to exponentially small splitting: Zero-Hopf bifurcations of arbitrary co-dimension
summary: In this paper, we present a geometric approach to exponentially small splitting in zero-Hopf bifurcations of arbitrary co-dimension. In further details, we consider a family of problems that generalizes the third order Michelsen/Kuramoto-Sivashinsky-type equations $ε^{2(κ-1)} f'''+f'={Q}(f)$, where ${Q}$ is an arbitrary real polynomial with $κ=\operatorname{degree}Q\ge 2$ simple real roots.
